meta.title: Strickle
meta.description: Your pay agent: irregular income, a regular salary.

home.title: Home
home.emptyTitle: Your next salary will appear here
home.emptyBody: Once your first payment arrives, the agent shows the date, the amount and the rule behind it.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyBody: When the agent splits a payment or pays your salary, you see what it did, which rule applied and what you can still change.

boxes.title: Boxes
boxes.emptyTitle: Your boxes are not set up yet
boxes.emptyBody: Taxes, cash, emergency fund, salary and profit each get their own box once you finish setup.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emptyBody: You will pause the agent, change its rules and share a read-only view with your accountant from this screen.

verify.title: Verify
verify.emptyBody: Certificates of income are not issued yet. When they are, you will be able to check one here.

docs.title: Docs
docs.emptyBody: When it is, this page links to it. Until then, each rule the agent applies is shown next to the number it produces.

profile.title: How do you get paid today?
profile.stablecoinHint: USDC, USDT or another dollar stablecoin
profile.bank: Through a bank or a platform
profile.bankHint: Deel, Payoneer, Wise, Upwork or a bank transfer

regime.title: Which regime are you in?
regime.other: Another regime, or I am not sure
regime.hint: Not sure is fine: we use a flat estimate until you confirm it.

income.title: Your income and your salary
income.goal: Salary you want each month (US dollars)
income.fromSimulator: Taken from the simulator. Change it if it is not right.

history.title: Your usual payments
history.notice: Importing twelve months of real income is not available yet. Strickle will learn from this estimate until your own payments arrive.

review.title: What Strickle will do
review.failed: We could not work out your plan just now.
review.taxLine: {rate} of each payment goes to taxes, by {regime}
review.taxAnnual: {rate} of each payment goes to taxes: {regime} asks for no payment in advance at your income, but the yearly tax is still owed
review.taxFixed: About {rate} of each payment goes to taxes: a typical month of the fixed fee of {regime}
review.taxFallback: {rate} of each payment goes to taxes, a flat estimate until your regime is confirmed
review.unverified: An estimate, not tax advice. Not yet verified by an accountant.
review.reasonNoRule: We have no coded rule for your country yet.
review.reasonOther: You are not in a regime we code yet.
review.reasonRate: The exchange rate was not available just now.
review.reasonExpired: The rule for your country has expired.
review.reasonNeedsYear: Your country's rule needs last year's tax figures, which we do not have yet.
review.reasonOutOfRegime: Your income is outside the regime we code for your country.
review.assumeAbroad: Assumes your clients are outside your country.
review.monthNote: The first month fills your operating cash first, so later months split differently.
review.salaryPending: {amount} stays pending until your income covers it
review.firstSalary: Your first salary can be paid about 24 hours after you finish: the vault applies a new payee after one day.
review.approval: Each salary payment waits for your approval until you change that in Settings.
review.estimateBased: Your plan starts from your own estimate until your real payments arrive.
review.confirm: These percentages are my starting point
review.warning: Check before you collect in digital dollars

create.title: Create your account
create.username: Choose a name for your passkey
create.usernameHint: It only helps you recognize it. It is not a password.
create.loginHint: Use the passkey name you chose when you created your account.

steps.agent: Handing your plan to the agent

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot create passkeys. Try a recent version of Chrome, Safari or Edge.
errors.cancelled: The passkey was not created. You can try again.
errors.failed: The account could not be created yet. Your passkey and your recovery code are kept. Try again.
errors.notFound: No account found for that passkey.

recovery.title: Save your recovery code
recovery.body: This code opens your agent's notices on a new device. Strickle cannot recover it for you. Write it down or keep it in a password manager.
recovery.label: Your recovery code
recovery.confirmBody: Type group {a} and group {b} of the code.
recovery.mismatch: Those groups do not match the code. Check and try again.

restore.title: Restore your notices
restore.body: Enter the recovery code you saved when you created your account.
restore.label: Recovery code
restore.invalid: That code is not valid. Check it for typing mistakes.
restore.mismatch: That code does not open your notices. Check that it belongs to this account.
restore.unverified: The code is valid. It is checked the first time your agent sends a notice.
restore.done: Your notices are restored on this device.

done.title: Your boxes are ready
done.reading: The agent is reading your plan
done.waiting: This can take a few minutes. You can go to your home now.

errors.income: Enter a whole number from 100 to 1,000,000.
errors.goal: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
errors.days: Pick different days from 1 to 28 for each payment.

salary.payNow: {amount} can be paid on that day
salary.pending: {amount} waits until your cushion allows it

reasons.insufficient-history: There is not enough real income history yet.
reasons.spend-unknown: Your monthly spending is not set yet.
reasons.cushion-floor: Your cushion would drop below its floor.
reasons.scenario-risk: Too many scenarios would fall below your floor.
reasons.salary-box: Your salary box does not hold enough yet.
reasons.paused: Your agent is paused. Nothing moves until you resume it.
reasons.halted: Your agent stopped itself to protect you. Open Settings to see why.
reasons.approval: Your salary is above the amount the agent may pay without your signature.

cushion.unknown: Set your monthly spending to see your cushion

strip.title: Next 60 days
strip.above: {percent} of scenarios stay above your floor
strip.estimate: Built on the income you estimated. It becomes real as payments arrive.
strip.summary: Cash forecast for the next 60 days against a floor of {floor}: the cautious path ends at {low} and the typical path at {mid}.

signedOut.title: Open your account
signedOut.body: Create your account or sign in to see your next salary.

noKey.title: This device cannot read your plan
noKey.body: Your plan is encrypted and only a device holding your notice key can open it. Your boxes are still visible.

waiting.title: Your plan is on its way
waiting.body: The agent publishes your plan after its first daily check. It can take up to a day.

error.title: We could not load your account
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

states.activityDown: Your activity is unavailable right now. Balances are up to date.

boxesPage.noTarget: No target: whatever is left lands here
boxesPage.eurc: Also holds {amount} in euro digital dollars

empty.title: No payments yet
empty.body: When money arrives, you will see here how it was divided between your boxes.
